user_evidence.symptom: TypeError after V60 header and V46 control deck on public Streamlit production

mission: Reproduce the real verified-matchup path, identify the exact TypeError, apply the smallest additive presentation/runtime repair, then prove branch and public production GREEN.

root_cause.cause: ESPN event date parses as a timezone-aware pandas Timestamp while the date-only slate cutoff parses as timezone-naive. Pandas raises TypeError when comparing them.
root_cause.why_prior_proof_missed_it: Previous Step 4 public proof used the default/current slate path and did not force the verified 2026-09-24 matchup. A clean branch-local exact-date run also did not deterministically receive the same upstream timestamp shape, so only the public exact-date reproduction exposed the production failure.

acceptance: public production 2026-09-24 Atlanta @ Green Bay path has no TypeError
Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love picker cards both render

patch.change: Parse both cutoff_date and ESPN event date with utc=True before normalize/compare.
